Why is the modifier blocked?
WHAT HAPPENED
CPT 44180 is bundled into CPT 44207 under the active NCCI edit used by this Case Builder.
WHY IT HAPPENED
The edit is treated as non-bypassable. When the NCCI modifier indicator is 0, a distinct-service modifier cannot be used to override the pair. CMS NCCI PTP edit: CPT 44207 is Column 1 and CPT 44180 is Column 2; modifier indicator 0; CPT separate procedure definition.
MODIFIERS AFFECTED
Modifier 59, XS, XE, XP, and XU are not permitted for this code pair.
WHAT TO CONSIDER NEXT
If documentation shows substantially increased work, unusual complexity, longer operative time, or technical difficulty on the primary procedure, review whether modifier 22 on the primary procedure is supportable. Also confirm payer-specific policy. This is educational support, not billing or legal advice.
